title: Európai és magyar irodalom- és zenetörténet (Consolidation)
grammar: Comprehensive review of the official European and Hungarian literary and musical canon

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can talk about European and Hungarian literature and music and their best-known works.
I can match authors and composers with their works.
I can read a longer text about European and Hungarian literature and music.
I can answer simple questions about the authors and composers of this unit.
